title: SCA Rosh Hashanah Message: "Owning Up To It" by Rabbi Joey Soffer

chapters.title: Preparation for Rosh Hashanah
chapters.about: Using the Yetzer hara to grow

summary: Rabbi Soffer discusses two types of Teshuvah, amputation and transformation, as we approach Rosh Hashanah. He shares a study by sociologist Charles Bosk regarding neurosurgeons and how they handle mistakes. The message is to own up to mistakes and use the Yetzer hara to grow.
questions: What are the two main types of Teshuvah?
How does Charles Bosk's study relate to neurosurgeons?
Why is owning up to mistakes important for growth?
